name: com.gmbsync/gmbsync-mcp
title: GMBSync Remote MCP Server
description: Audit Google Business Profiles, generate <15KB review widgets, JSON-LD, and AI replies.

tools.name: scan_business_google_reviews
tools.description: Search any business on Google Maps to inspect its live star rating, total verified reviews, Google Rich Snippet SEO readiness, and interactive GMBSync storefront preview link.

query.description: Business name and city or region to look up on Google Maps (for example: "Apex Dental Studio Austin" or "WeBuyClubz").

platform.description: Optional storefront platform to tailor the recommended rich snippet and widget setup steps.

tools.name: generate_review_widget_embed
tools.description: Generate ready-to-paste, zero-CLS (<15KB) Google review widget installation code or Shopify Online Store 2.0 Theme App Block instructions with AggregateRating JSON-LD.

platform.description: Target website or e-commerce platform where the Google review widget will be installed.

layout.description: Visual widget layout: carousel slider, masonry review grid, compact product rating strip, or floating corner trust badge.

theme.description: Color surface mode matching the merchant storefront background (light or dark).

min_stars.description: Minimum Google star rating filter to display on the storefront (default is 4 for 4+ star reviews).

widget_id.description: Optional GMBSync widget ID (wdg_...) or location ID (loc_...) from the merchant dashboard.

shop_domain.description: Optional Shopify myshopify.com domain (for example: "brand-store.myshopify.com") for zero-ID automatic store linking.

tools.name: get_gmbsync_pricing_and_integrations
tools.description: Retrieve structured GMBSync subscription plans (Free, Pro, Growth & AI, Agency), annual billing savings, performance benchmarks, and direct Shopify/Web onboarding links.

billing_interval.description: Billing cycle to inspect: monthly, annual (20% discount), or both.
